scope: 695 development people, 1064 records; original175 plus additional520
outer_split: Preserve original175 person folds; permute sorted additional520 person IDs with new_person_seed; assign 104 people per fold without labels.

pls.outputs: joint left/right GDI, PLSRegression directly; no additional Ridge

standardization: StandardScaler fit on each training slice only; no Y scaling
selection: pooled inner out-of-person front MAE, each person equal; refit transforms and predictor on outer training people only
tie: smallest component count within 1e-12 of minimum inner MAE
old140_reference: reuse existing fold heads trained on original140 people; evaluate on exactly the same expanded held139 as other methods
fitting_weights: records equal, paired left/right output; metric weights people equal
score_bins: floor(GDI/10), no clipping; exact match is exploratory, not a validated clinical score

paired_bootstrap.interpretation: exploratory conditional OOF intervals, not independent final evaluation
